description: This file defines the CommonCodecTypeFilter class which provides utility methods for filtering types, specifically checking whether a type is an abstract or framework type within Orleans serialization context.

classes.name: CommonCodecTypeFilter
classes.description: Provides static methods to determine if a type is an abstract or framework type based on attributes and assembly information.

methods.name: IsAbstractOrFrameworkType
methods.description: Checks whether the provided type is either abstract, marked with the GeneratedCode attribute for OrleansCodeGen, or part of the framework via the FrameworkPart attribute.
